body.heading: Where in the world is São Tomé and Príncipe?
paragraphs: São Tomé and Príncipe is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of São Tomé and Príncipe is São Tomé.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in São Tomé and Príncipe is Portuguese.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of São Tomé and Príncipe is the São Tomé and Príncipe dobra.

body.heading: How big is São Tomé and Príncipe?
paragraphs: São Tomé and Príncipe covers about 964 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Comoros.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Pico Cão Grande is a needle of volcanic rock spearing up from the rainforest of São Tomé — it looks like a mountain from a fairy tale.
This tiny island sits exactly on the Equator line — you can stand with one foot in each hemisphere, then swim at its quiet beaches.

body.heading: Think and talk

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
